midi.ccRule: CC number = param index + 1 for params 1..126 (except pseudo slots 5, 97, 98)
midi.nrpnRule: NRPN number = param index - 128 for params 128..(numSoundParams-1); CC99 MSB, CC98 LSB, CC6 value
midi.kitSelect: CC0 (bank select MSB) value = kit RAM slot
midi.patternSelect: Program change on the global channel
